program_or_activity: Purchased Long Term Services and Supports (PLTSS)
required_positive_evidence: Source text must separate and quantify recoverable incorrect-amount PLTSS overpayments, or otherwise tie bills-of-collection process results to collectible-dollar amounts, apart from documentation, timeliness, technical, unknown-payment, and non-recoverable categories.
blocked_translation: Do not translate the PLTSS bills-of-collection process boundary, post-payment review process, or reported improper and unknown payment estimate into a waste-reduction score until the recoverable incorrect-amount subset and collectible-dollar basis are supported.
next_source_target: VA or VHA PLTSS payment-integrity, bills-of-collection, medical-review, debt-management, or AFR materials that tie incorrect-amount post-payment review findings to recoverable or collectible overpayment dollars.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology component gate progress requirement row only; not a savings estimate and not a finding of waste.
